show.description: After being betrayed on her wedding day, Avni’s life takes a drastic turn when Mayur, a humble tiffin delivery man with a hidden past, marries her to protect her dignity and fulfill her father’s last wish. What begins as a fake marriage slowly evolves into something deeper, as secrets, emotions, and truths begin to unfold. Watch Now!
